odd_map_f.description: Canonical odd map induced by the oscillator change of variables a_1^sigma -> a_1^sigma + kappa*S^sigma, S^sigma = sum_l (gb_{sigma,l,-} b_l^+ - gb_{sigma,l,+} b_l^-); X(a + kappa S, b) = X(a,b) + kappa f(X). Constant terms of f(X) are dropped (listed in dropped_constant_terms).
odd_map_f.parameterization: f(Z_j) = sum_i phi_ij Z_i ; records give (j, i, phi_ij)
